content:
At dawn the quiet windows glow,  
soft gold on every sleeping stone;  
the river hums a song below  
and carries yesterday alone.

A sparrow stitches up the sky  
with thread of wing and silver call,  
while clouds like lanterns drift on by,  
and shadows loosen from the wall.

So take the morning in your hand,  
a fragile cup of light and air;  
the world is wide, the hours are sand,  
and wonder waits for you somewhere.
